title: Product stable influence
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For $0<\rho\leq1$, the stable influence of $f$ at coordinate $i$ is $\rho^{-1}$ times the product noise stability at parameter $\rho$ of the coordinate Laplacian of $f$ at $i$.
